common: Paint an original premium fantasy tabletop adventure book illustration, matching the painterly treatment of the supplied reference, NOT its subjects or setting. Traditional oil and gouache textures, beautifully observed materials and anatomy, atmospheric depth, warm natural ochres, cool slate shadows, controlled rich colors, expressive but believable creatures. Not cartoon, anime, photography or shiny 3D. No imitation of any named living artist. Irregular dry-brushed edges dissolving into warm ivory parchment, no rectangular frame. Keep important faces, fingers and creature anatomy within the central 80 percent. No writing, labels, numbers, logo, watermark, speech bubbles, diagrams or overhead map. No player characters, presumed player action, combat outcome, hidden passage, hidden treasure, future transformation or unexplained extra character. Only depict the visible subject described for this image; do not import elements of other images or a larger conspiracy. No new magical effects or graphic gore. Paint the actual room or character as an illustration of a discovery, not a mechanically exact map. Cave paintings can use restrained painterly ambient illumination without adding torches or changing gameplay lighting. Preserve the visual richness and soft integrated edges of the existing book illustrations.

images.label: Le dragonnet de cuivre et les kobolds
images.source: Manuscrit, Le dragonnet dans le garde-manger ; Copper Dragon Wyrmling, D&D Beyond, identité visuelle de dragon métallique.
images.prompt: Inside a modest rocky cave pantry, a very young copper dragon sits awkwardly between grain sacks and bundles of dried provisions. Lustrous reddish-copper metallic scales, a classic four-legged dragon with two folded membranous wings, long tail, small back-swept horns and alert expressive eyes. This is a hatchling of about pony size, NOT an enormous adult, bronze dragon, orange lizard or wyvern. Two much smaller kobolds, thin reptilian humanoids with russet scales, small horned heads and tails, wear simple earth-colored scraps of clothing. One timidly offers a few shiny copper or gold coins; the other holds an old bright spoon with an uncertain look. The dragon seems unhappy and demanding rather than attacking. The kobolds are embarrassed and fascinated, not worshipping a god. Gentle situational humor without slapstick or baby toys. Worn baskets, straw and rock textures, no throne, no egg or nest shown, no cave entrances or traps. A balanced horizontal group composition, creature anatomy clear and believable, nothing burned or dead.

images.label: La fontaine et le méphite de vapeur
images.source: Manuscrit, La fontaine rompue : source jaillissant d’une fontaine brisée, méphite écoutant l’eau.
images.prompt: An intimate underground chamber of smooth old mortared stone interrupted by natural rock. A damaged ancient stone fountain releases a clear little spring that runs across the floor toward an unseen neighboring chamber. Damp masonry, softened broken carvings, reflections and a delicate veil of warm vapor. One small mischievous steam mephit perches near the fountain, listening to the water with curious pleasure: a little winged elemental imp, roughly cat-sized to small-child-sized, grey-white steamy body, batlike wings, small pointed features, semi-misty extremities, not a giant humanoid cloud or a fire demon. Humidity and the contrast of ancient masonry with moving water are the focus. No characters, prisoners, skulls, inscriptions, staircase, treasure chest, concealed door, poison or hostile attack. This depicts only the fountain room, not a composite floor plan of several rooms. Wide quiet interior composition with the small mephit giving scale.

images.label: La nothic dans son laboratoire
images.source: Manuscrit, laboratoire isolé ; D&D Beyond Nothic : créature monstrueuse à grandes griffes et un œil unique. Les détails non décrits sont artistiques.
images.prompt: A true D&D nothic occupied at a cluttered stone laboratory bench. A hunched misshapen lean humanoid MONSTER, mottled grey-green leathery skin, bony spines on its upper back, long sinewy arms and wickedly hooked claws, ONE enormous single yellow-green eye dominating its strange head above a small toothy mouth. Absolutely not a one-eyed human woman, cyclops giant, eyepatched wizard, beholder or beautiful elf. No hair, human female features or human breasts. The nothic leans sideways over old metal instruments, a clay retort and shut worn books, its single eye turned toward the visitor with wary intelligent curiosity. A remnant of a ragged dark cloth around its waist, no ornate wizard robe, no magical aura. The former identity is not illustrated. No corpse, cage, key, glowing spell, open readable book, bell picture or bell-shaped prop. A subtle old sword can rest inconspicuously against a table but is not attacking or glowing. Character-focused vertical composition, real tactile creature anatomy, the hand holding a mundane instrument is unambiguously clawed.

images.label: L’anniversaire de la cheffe gobeline
images.source: Manuscrit, Le trône d’anniversaire : cheffe gobeline, quatre guerriers gobelins, chapeau, mirliton et siège bancal.
images.prompt: A lively goblin birthday party in a torchlit rocky cavern. Exactly one female goblin chief at a rickety improvised wooden throne with a plain battered cushion, wearing an absurd pointed mustard-colored cloth party hat and blowing a small crude wooden kazoo. FOUR other goblin warriors are making enthusiastic discordant music and dancing, for a total of five goblins. Small green-olive humanoids, large pointed ears, sharp expressive features, rough earth-colored clothing and scavenged belts. Their weapons are set aside. A crushed rustic cake, a brightly polished big animal tooth and awkwardly wrapped gifts form funny still-life details. Warm amber torches illuminate smoky stone and rich worn fabrics. The tone is charmingly unruly, not a circus or a modern children's party. No balloons, modern plastic, confetti, readable banners or text. No dwarf prisoner, tapestry, hidden cache, shiny magical loot under the cushion, secret doorway or adventuring party. The chief and her birthday antics are the focal point, with an asymmetrical horizontal composition of believable distinct bodies and faces.

images.label: Dent-de-Braise sur son perchoir
images.source: Manuscrit, Le perchoir du dragonnet : dragonnet rouge, corniche à trois mètres, provisions et équipement abîmés.
images.prompt: An arrogant young red dragon wyrmling on a rocky ledge above a cavern floor. A small but fearsome classic red dragon with four legs, two folded batlike wings, a long tail, swept-back horns, distinct crimson scales and amber eyes. This is a wyrmling of roughly large-dog to pony scale, NOT an adult dragon filling a cathedral. He lifts his chin and looks imperiously down toward an unseen visitor, mouth closed or slightly parted, no breathing fire. The ledge is modestly elevated, with broken ordinary weapons, damaged armor and a couple of ale casks below providing scale. Slanting weak daylight gives red scales a subdued copper edge without making him metallic or bronze. No ogre, other dragon, coins changing hands, smoking victim, trophy skull, secret passage or identifiable treasure. Dynamic diagonally composed vertical portrait with the whole head and wings clearly framed, a subtle broad rock background and painterly parchment fade.

images.label: L’ours-hibou dans sa tanière
images.source: Manuscrit, La tanière et le ressaut : ours-hibou territorial parmi nids de feuilles et branches.
images.prompt: An immense powerful owlbear in its natural rocky den, standing beside a nest of leaves and broken branches. A believable D&D owlbear: massive quadrupedal bear body, dark tawny fur and interwoven feathers around the shoulders, an expressive owl-like facial disc with a strong hooked beak, feathered brow and sharp dark eyes. NOT a winged bird, griffin, ordinary bear with a decorative owl mask or creature with extra limbs. A sense of weight in its huge paws and shoulders; it has noticed something but is not attacking a depicted victim. Cool painterly ambient light on damp rock and warm plumage, deep recesses behind, rich texture and grounded scale. No person, dead brother, named corpse, gore, cultist, torch, secret doorway, upper hidden exit, skull pile or battle. A wide immersive ground-level scene, den architecture kept indistinct rather than disclosing a route through it.

images.label: Le minotaure entre les piliers
images.source: Manuscrit, Le labyrinthe de terre et de brique : minotaure de Baphomet, piliers épais et traces de sabots.
images.prompt: A visitor-height view into ancient underground galleries made of thick worn brick piers and packed earth, their arrangement partially hidden by shadow. Between two pillars stands a terrifying minotaur: a broad powerful humanoid body, truly bovine bull head, heavy curved horns, shaggy dark brown hair on head and shoulders, two muscular arms and two hoofed legs. No human face, goat head, centaur body, wings or extra limbs. The beast holds a plain battered heavy axe at rest rather than swinging it at anyone. Foreground worn brick and an indistinct receding corridor create depth, not an overhead maze diagram. Restrained cool painterly visibility and earthy warm reflected tones, no invented lantern or torch. No dead adventurers, secret door, treasure chest, glowing demonic sigil or named god emblem. The silhouette and architecture should dominate the horizontal composition, more tense and monumental than a standard standing monster portrait.

images.label: Narthus et la cloche du sanctuaire
images.source: Manuscrit et original : cloche noire suspendue, trois autels, estrade et cinq sièges, tentures violettes, officiant Narthus ; traits sous le capuchon non fixés.
images.prompt: The imposing inner room of a subterranean cult shrine, a premium fantasy book interior painting. A single black iron bell hangs from a sturdy simple support in the central space, ordinary iron with no glowing runes, eyes, skull shape or visible supernatural effects. THREE low stone altars face a modest raised dais bearing FIVE empty austere wooden chairs, mostly in shadow. Heavy faded purple hangings and red-flamed wall sconces, ancient worked stone with dark mineral veins. Narthus, the sole present cult officiant, stands near the bell with a small plain ritual bowl, wearing a charcoal robe and deep hood that leaves his specific face indistinct. He is an ordinary embodied cultist, NOT a Red Wizard: no scarlet robe, facial tattoos, crown, demon horns or lich features. He has not rung the bell and is not casting a visible spell. No Ivlis, Szass Tam, zombies, animated skeletons, summoned being, party, victim, hidden escape, letter or treasure. A little inert bone matter may remain peripheral but is not the focus; no graphic gore. Wide dramatic balanced interior composition, the bell and lone figure convey the room's scale, no floor-plan viewpoint.

Thoughtful sharp intelligent eyes, a face marked by ordinary age and conviction, composed unsettling half-smile, dark hair with a little grey at the temples, loose but simply arranged.
